# SLC Car Rental Services

> SLC Car Rental Services (SmartLink Consultants) is a car rental company in Kashif Bell-Air Plaza, G-8 Markaz, Islamabad, Pakistan, in business since 2013. It rents cars with a driver or as self drive in Islamabad and Rawalpindi, from the Suzuki Alto to the Toyota Land Cruiser V8, Mercedes S-Class, Lexus LX 570 and Coaster, with delivery to every sector. Daily rates start at PKR 4,000. Phone/WhatsApp +92 310 0000132. Open Mon–Sun, 24 hours.

## Key facts
- Office: Kashif Bell-Air Plaza, G-8 Markaz, Islamabad, Islamabad Capital Territory, Pakistan
- Phone: +92 310 0000132 · WhatsApp: +923100000132 · Email: smartlinkservicesg8@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sun, 24 hours
- Experience: 13 years (since 2013)
- Services: rent a car with driver, self drive (selected cars; CNIC, driving licence and refundable deposit), monthly and corporate contracts, Islamabad Airport pick and drop, wedding cars, out-of-city tours
- Organisations served: USAID, iEARN, Silkbank, TSL Builders, Kalon Chemicals, Muslim Hands, HelpInNeed, Emirates Group of Companies
- Daily rates (updated 18 October 2026): Suzuki Alto PKR 4,000; Suzuki Wagon R PKR 5,000; Toyota Yaris PKR 6,000; Honda City PKR 6,000; Toyota Corolla PKR 6,000; Toyota Corolla Grande PKR 7,000; Honda Civic 2022 PKR 7,000; Honda Civic 2025 PKR 10,000; Hyundai Elantra PKR 10,000; Honda BR-V PKR 7,000; Toyota Revo PKR 12,000; Toyota Prado PKR 15,000; Toyota Fortuner PKR 14,000; Kia Sportage PKR 15,000; Hyundai Tucson PKR 15,000; Toyota Land Cruiser V8 PKR 25,000; Mercedes-Benz S400 PKR 110,000; Mercedes-Benz S500 PKR 110,000; Mercedes-Benz E250 PKR 75,000; Mercedes-Benz C180 PKR 60,000; Audi A6 PKR 55,000; Audi A5 PKR 45,000; Audi A4 PKR 35,000; Lexus LX 570 PKR 150,000; Toyota Grand Cabin PKR 15,000; Toyota Coaster (4C) PKR 18,000; Toyota Coaster (5C) PKR 22,000
